heading: Winter in the Okanagan
title: Winter in the Okanagan: Things to Do | Okanagan Roam
description: Things to do in the Okanagan this winter: skiing and beyond, skating, snowshoeing, sleigh rides, holiday events, saunas, winter wine and cozy spots.
intro: Winter in the Okanagan means snow on the ski hills and quieter, frosty days in the valley below. There's plenty to do on and off the slopes, from skating and snowshoeing to sleigh rides, holiday markets and long, warm evenings by a fire.
Here are our winter guides, all built from verified listings.
